title: MaleTheme Solo #011 · 남 피트니스 모델·아이돌 내추럴·해적 테마·메탈릭
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Turkish man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a tin barrel-shaped weight, a tin square-sided cowbell, a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop with a heavy rough silver a hammer head hanging at its end, and a single mixed-metal anklet. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black tricorn pirate hat with a white skull emblem, a red bandana knotted at his neck, black leather wrist cuffs with gold studs, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic black leather with mirror-polished metallic gold buckles T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
